_comment: Editable ARPG map loot. See BALANCING-GUIDE.md. Restart server after edits. _comment strings are documentation and never affect rolls.
_npcOverridesExample: Copy map_normal as furnace_sentinel, then add "15001": "furnace_sentinel" inside npcOverrides. Overrides replace the whole rank table for that NPC, including elites.

crafting_materials._comment: Alchemy: create a rare from normal.
Regal: retain magic rolls and upgrade.
Exalted: intentionally the least common material.

tables._comment: Kill XP = this value x map tier. Rows roll independently. Copy this object and rename id to make an NPC-specific table.

rolls.label: Coins
rolls._comment: Guaranteed. Abundant currency map modifier doubles this amount.

rolls.label: Equipment
rolls._comment: Normal monsters: 1 in 3, or 1 in 2 on Abundant maps. Elite/boss: guaranteed. Item level is 2 x tier; introduction uses level1.

rolls.label: Crafting material
rolls._comment: One weighted choice from the named pool. Quantity is a stack of that one material.

rolls.label: Active or support gem
rolls._comment: Half active, half support. Level = 1 + floor(tier / 2), capped20.

rolls.label: Spare same-tier map
rolls._comment: Optional sustain. Champion progression map is guaranteed separately in MapRuns.

rolls.label: Extra support gem
rolls._comment: Non-boss monsters only; minimum gem level1.

rolls.label: Portal scroll
rolls._comment: Guaranteed two from a boss; otherwise 1 in 10.
